skills.short_description: Pull enemies into a damaging control zone.
skills.long_description: Place a singularity that drags enemies backward and groups them for area damage.

skills.short_description: Trap a lane position and rewind enemies.
skills.long_description: Place a mine that displaces the first enemies crossing it and exposes them to follow-up damage.

skills.short_description: Summon allied soldiers to hold the lane.
skills.long_description: Deploy a temporary squad that advances, attacks enemies, and buys time for the tower.

skills.short_description: Build a temporary soldier-producing structure.
skills.long_description: Place a barracks that periodically creates allied soldiers until it expires or is destroyed.

skills.short_description: Weaken enemies inside a marked area.
skills.long_description: Expose armor and resistance so the tower and allied units deal more damage to marked enemies.

skills.short_description: Heal and empower allied units.
skills.long_description: Restore allied health and grant soldiers a short damage and speed boost.

skills.short_description: Place a temporary autonomous tower.
skills.long_description: Build a small turret that attacks nearby enemies until its lifetime ends.

skills.short_description: Slow enemies and apply Freeze in a cold zone.
skills.long_description: Cover an area in cold that reduces enemy speed, applies a deterministic Freeze state, and makes clustered targets easier to control.

skills.short_description: Send drones to hunt or support units.
skills.long_description: Release a temporary swarm that attacks priority enemies and can be specialized toward disruption or defense.

skills.short_description: Soak enemies and weaken a control area.
skills.long_description: A data-composed elemental pulse that applies Soak and weakness, creating a predictable setup state for Stormcaller reactions.

skills.short_description: Fire a frequent direct-damage projectile.
skills.long_description: A low-cooldown hardcast that builds Arcane Cadence for larger Arcanist finishers and leaves a brief Shock trace for reaction builds.

skills.short_description: Resolve elemental reactions across a marked group.
skills.long_description: A Stormcaller finisher that resolves Shock, Soak, and Ignite combinations in a deterministic order before striking the area.

skills.short_description: Snapshot a battlefield state for later restoration.
skills.long_description: A Chronomancer field snapshots enemy position and health, delays movement, and restores the captured state when the anchor resolves. Dead enemies are never resurrected.

skills.short_description: Start a deterministic infection chain.
skills.long_description: The first Plaguewright spell marks a host so later mutations and corpse interactions can spread the epidemic.

skills.short_description: Convert a safe field drop into starter Scrap.
skills.long_description: A Salvager setup action that creates a reclaimable battlefield remain without requiring a separate drone-summoning skill.

skills.short_description: Designate a priority target for Trophy payout.
skills.long_description: A Bounty Hunter mark makes the dangerous target visible and rewards deliberate isolation and execution.

skills.short_description: Command the bonded pet to leap to a target area.
skills.long_description: A Beastmaster loadout automatically bonds one persistent pet at run start. Pounce sends that pet from anywhere in the arena to the chosen point and deals area damage based on the pet's basic attack damage.

skills.short_description: Predict and bombard a delayed area.
skills.long_description: An Artillerist cast rewards aiming at where enemies will be, with slow shells and large consequences for misses.

skills.short_description: Displace enemies through a deterministic spatial rift.
skills.long_description: A Void Shepherd field manipulates positions without relying on generic slow effects or nondeterministic portal outcomes.

skills.short_description: Shield a zone and turn protection into Resolve.
skills.long_description: An Oathkeeper ward protects the tower and allies, creating explicit defensive mastery rather than passive generic durability.

skills.short_description: Improve the next visible deterministic Fate event.
skills.long_description: A Fatebinder utility cast manipulates named outcomes without changing the global combat stream or replay determinism.

skills.short_description: Spend tower life for a stronger area strike.
skills.long_description: A Bloodbinder attack converts a controlled amount of tower health into a deterministic area strike. The resulting Blood Debt increases later Bloodbinder damage until Life Siphon reduces it.

skills.short_description: Convert allied summons into tower recovery.
skills.long_description: The base cast sacrifices the weakest eligible allied summon and clears part of Blood Debt. The HARVEST branch sacrifices every eligible summon in the target area and converts their remaining health into capped healing; TITHE drains a bounded portion from each survivor instead. Neither branch targets the tower or resurrects a unit, and empty authored branch areas reject the cast.

skills.short_description: Turn one enemy against its former allies.
skills.long_description: Mark the strongest eligible non-boss enemy in an area. It temporarily changes allegiance, attacks nearby hostile enemies, and exposes itself for deliberate Usurper follow-up.

skills.short_description: Seed a bounded riot across an enemy cluster.
skills.long_description: Confuse a deterministic enemy cluster so hostile units fight across the boundary for a short window. Bosses receive confusion and vulnerability instead of permanent allegiance conversion.

skills.short_description: Send a storm cloud that repeatedly applies Shock.
skills.long_description: Move a slow storm cloud through the selected area. Its bounded pulses deal light damage, apply Shock, and reward conductive reactions without runaway chaining.

skills.short_description: Send a directional wave that Soaks and pushes.
skills.long_description: Release a broad deterministic wave along the chosen direction. It deals light damage, pushes normal enemies, and applies Soaked for reaction setup.

skills.short_description: Ignite an area and trigger cold-state reactions.
skills.long_description: Release a deterministic heat surge that applies Ignite. Soaked or Frozen enemies trigger Steam Burst, while Shocked enemies trigger Plasma Burst.

skills.short_description: Gather enemies and resolve a prepared reaction.
skills.long_description: Create a vortex that pulls enemies toward its center. Once per cast it resolves a prepared Shock and Soak cluster into a bounded storm burst.

skills.short_description: Place a durable blocker that enemies can attack.
skills.long_description: Place a deterministic wall segment on the lane. Ground enemies route toward it and attack it on contact rather than becoming stuck; connected wall talents can later extend the segment.

skills.short_description: Place a rearming floor trap in a walkable cell.
skills.long_description: Set a compact trap with limited charges. It triggers when a ground enemy enters, deals area damage, and rearms after a deterministic delay so walls can funnel repeated crossings.

skills.short_description: Speed up allied actors in an area.
skills.long_description: Advance allied attack cadence, movement, and nearby structure timers for a short deterministic window. It creates Paradox debt instead of accelerating global simulation time.

skills.short_description: Postpone a hostile event.
skills.long_description: Increase the target enemy's hostile-event delay and briefly expose it. Deterministic fallback targeting chooses the nearest eligible enemy in the selected area.

skills.short_description: Send enemies backward along the lane.
skills.long_description: Move eligible enemies backward through legal lane space and briefly suspend their next action. It cannot duplicate deaths, rewards, or consumed effects.

skills.short_description: Refresh another skill for Paradox debt.
skills.long_description: Refresh the first other cooling skill deterministically. The refresh creates heavy Paradox debt and cannot target itself or an ultimate.

skills.short_description: Deliver a heavy priority-target strike.
skills.long_description: Fires at the strongest eligible enemy. The shot deals substantially more damage when Harpoon or positioning has isolated the active bounty.

skills.short_description: Pull a priority target away from its group.
skills.long_description: Drags the strongest eligible enemy backward and slows it. This creates the isolation window that makes Deadeye Shot and bounty objectives more valuable.

skills.short_description: Reveal a deterministic weakness on one target.
skills.long_description: Assigns a visible weakness category to the target and exposes it briefly. Future class-specific upgrades can reward matching projectile, summon, structure, elemental, or direct damage.

skills.short_description: Send a drone to secure the active Trophy.
skills.long_description: Deploys a non-combat drone that navigates to the active bounty and converts its completed mark into a Trophy. It does not replace the bounty's combat reward.

skills.short_description: Spread infection between nearby hosts.
skills.long_description: Command disease-carrying vectors to copy infection to a bounded number of nearby uninfected enemies. Existing hosts determine the strain and generation.

skills.short_description: Evolve infected enemies into a chosen strain.
skills.long_description: Spend Biomass to transform infected targets into Necrotic, Rabid, Spore, or Symbiotic strains. The chosen strain remains visible in the target state.

skills.short_description: Burst an infected host and spread its disease.
skills.long_description: Detonate the strongest infected host in the target area. The burst deals damage, spreads a reduced infection, and generates Biomass without recursive chains.

skills.short_description: Contain and amplify infection in an area.
skills.long_description: Create a boundary that keeps infection activity local while amplifying infected-host damage and progression inside it.

skills.short_description: Spend Scrap to place a rearming mine.
skills.long_description: Convert battlefield Scrap into a temporary trap. It triggers on enemy contact, deals area damage, and re-arms for later crossings.

skills.short_description: Spend Scrap to build a disposable turret.
skills.long_description: Build a cheap autonomous turret whose lifetime and damage scale with its Scrap investment. It is weaker than a permanent tower but available during the wave.

skills.short_description: Dismantle a temporary object for Scrap.
skills.long_description: Destroy one eligible temporary building and recover a capped portion of its remaining material value. It cannot dismantle the core tower.

skills.short_description: Spend stored Scrap on a powerful weapon.
skills.long_description: Convert all currently carried Scrap into one temporary bombardment structure. Saving more Scrap makes the weapon stronger, but delays your economy's next purchase.

skills.short_description: Reveal projected enemy positions.
skills.long_description: Mark enemies with deterministic future-position data so delayed bombardments and line shots can reward prediction.

skills.short_description: Fire a massive line shot.
skills.long_description: Strike every eligible enemy along a wide deterministic horizontal lane. Predicted targets take a controlled accuracy bonus.

skills.short_description: Deliver a delayed cluster bombardment.
skills.long_description: Place a delayed shell that bursts repeatedly across its target area. The impact is predictable and rewards a Spotter setup.

skills.short_description: March explosions through a predicted lane.
skills.long_description: Create a slow, deterministic sequence of impacts that advances across the chosen lane rather than chasing current enemy positions.

skills.short_description: Teleport enemies toward a chosen point.
skills.long_description: Compress a group toward the selected location. Instability rises with every spatial manipulation, making repeated control increasingly risky.

skills.short_description: Remove one enemy from the arena briefly.
skills.long_description: Phase the strongest eligible target out of the simulation for a bounded duration. Bosses return sooner and never lose rewards or state permanently.

skills.short_description: Swap the positions of two enemies.
skills.long_description: Exchange two stable enemy positions within the field. The operation changes route pressure without duplicating units or rewards.

skills.short_description: Create a field that displaces crossing enemies.
skills.long_description: Place a spatial boundary that pushes enemies backward while raising Instability. It does not form an infinite portal loop.

skills.short_description: Summon a defender to intercept attacks.
skills.long_description: Create a temporary allied defender near the target. It is durable but replaceable and converts prevented pressure into Resolve.

skills.short_description: Challenge a threat and build Resolve.
skills.long_description: Mark a target as the current defensive challenge, exposing it and rewarding clean interception of its pressure.

skills.short_description: Heal and protect allies in a zone.
skills.long_description: Create a defensive ground zone that heals allied units over time and converts successful protection into Resolve.

skills.short_description: Spend Resolve on a retaliatory strike.
skills.long_description: Convert stored Resolve into a deterministic area attack. The spell is strongest after the player has fulfilled defensive conditions.

skills.short_description: Expose enemies to a bad deterministic outcome.
skills.long_description: Apply a visible hostile setback: slowed movement and increased vulnerability. Fate gained here represents accepting the revealed downside.

skills.short_description: Fire a deterministic high-variance strike.
skills.long_description: Deal a variable-looking attack whose result is fixed by the run seed and visible Fate state. It becomes stronger after Stack the Deck.

skills.short_description: Improve the next visible Fate event.
skills.long_description: Bank a favorable deterministic modifier for the next Fate-tagged outcome and show the event window in the UI.

skills.short_description: Wager Fate to refresh another skill.
skills.long_description: Spend a bounded Fate wager to refresh the first other cooling skill. The refresh is deterministic and cannot target itself or an ultimate.

skills.short_description: Turn tower health into a lingering blood zone.
skills.long_description: Pay a controlled Blood cost to create a damaging field that increases Blood Debt and weakens enemies inside it.

skills.short_description: Sacrifice tower life to summon a durable golem.
skills.long_description: Convert tower health into one temporary frontline ally. Its remaining health can later be harvested by Life Siphon.

skills.short_description: Spend Blood Debt on a desperate burst.
skills.long_description: Release a tower-centered pulse whose strength grows with Blood Debt, then clear part of that debt.

skills.short_description: Control one enemy and redirect its attacks.
skills.long_description: Convert a stable non-boss enemy for a short window. Controlled targets prioritize hostile enemies and cannot recursively convert others.

skills.short_description: Confuse a group with contradictory commands.
skills.long_description: Create a bounded confusion field. Enemies inside may attack nearby allies, while bosses receive exposure instead of permanent conversion.

skills.short_description: Link enemies so damage echoes between them.
skills.long_description: Mark a target group and echo a capped portion of direct damage between linked enemies without recursive chains.

skills.short_description: Feed the bonded beast from a battlefield remain.
skills.long_description: Consume the nearest eligible corpse to heal the bonded pet and increase Bond. Feeding is a command, not a second summon.

skills.short_description: Give the bonded beast a contextual trait.
skills.long_description: Select a deterministic adaptation for the pet: armored hide, lightning glands, regeneration, burrowing, or spiked carapace.

skills.short_description: Regroup and empower allied beasts and soldiers.
skills.long_description: Call the bonded pet to the target area and grant a formation buff to nearby allied units. It never creates another permanent pet.

skills.short_description: Assign the bonded pet a priority target.
skills.long_description: Mark one enemy for the pet to pursue from anywhere in the arena. The command improves basic pet attacks for a short, deterministic window.
